name: FOREST
description: A large area of land covered with many trees growing close together

name: ISLAND
description: A body of land entirely surrounded by water; a place set apart from the whole

name: DESERT
description: A vast dry land where little grows; an empty expanse of heat and sand

name: FRUIT
description: The ripe product of a plant that holds the seed; the sweet result of growth

name: HONEY
description: A sweet golden substance made by bees; symbol of natural sweetness and reward

name: WINE
description: A drink made from fermented fruit; symbol of celebration and transformation

name: DOCTOR
description: One who heals the sick and tends to the body; a learned person of medicine

name: PRIEST
description: One who leads in sacred matters and speaks between the human and the divine

name: WARRIOR
description: One who fights with courage and skill; a person trained for battle

name: LEADER
description: One who guides others by example or authority; the one at the front of a group

name: ARTIST
description: One who creates from inner vision; a person who gives form to feeling and thought

name: HUSBAND
description: A man joined to another in marriage; one who provides care and partnership

name: WIFE
description: A woman joined to another in marriage; one who shares life and nurtures bonds

name: HOUR
description: A division of the day into twenty-four equal parts; a measured span of passing time

name: MONTH
description: One cycle of the moon; a period of roughly thirty days within a year

name: CENTURY
description: A span of one hundred years; a measure of lasting and historical time

name: BROWN
description: The color of earth and wood; a warm dark shade between red and black

name: GREY
description: The color between black and white; a neutral shade of muted light

name: UNLESS
description: Except on the condition that; a word that marks what must hold for a thing to follow

name: HOWEVER
description: Despite what was said; a word that turns thought in another direction while connecting
